newsitem.title: MALTA: Yields unchanged on Malta T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields unchanged on Malta T-bills.

text.p: Yields will remain unchanged on 28-day and 91-day treasury bills being issued in Malta on Friday, the Treasury said on Thursday.
It said it would issue 3.6 million lira ($9.9 million) in 28-day bills maturing on November 15. The yield is 4.99 percent, the same as the previous issue of October 4.
The Treasury will also issue 155,000 lira ($426,250) in 91-day bills maturing on January 17, 1997, and yielding 4.99 percent, the same as the October 4 issue.
